lines.text: Now try it in the Java simulator.
Run the auto called two, Drive To Pose. Then open the newest log in AdvantageScope.
Put drivetrain pose on the field view, and Drive To Pose commanded velocity on a graph.
Find the shape: speed up, maybe cruise, a smooth brake, then a gentle glide.
Now change K P from six to two, and run it again.
That's the gentle P robot from the race. The end should turn into a long creep.
Put it back. Change one number at a time, or explore the Python simulator in tools, align sim.
Next video: measuring the tag, so the goal is the real one.
